_note: The copy of the approved brand references (2026-10-21), verbatim: the few-shot examples for every headline, body, chip, CTA and visual concept on a social graphic (make-content skill, brief.template.json _help.copyRules). Feed posts and ads address the reader with "Sie" (the A refs are Facebook ads; their style is also the bar for Facebook and LinkedIn posts); carousels use "du", one idea per slide, sentence case. pattern: one of patterns below. Rules and the CTA list: config/copy_rules.json.

patterns.contrast_pair: two short sentences, the second turns the first: "Ihr Vertrieb schläft. Unsere KI nicht."
patterns.benefit_pair: less of the pain, more of the gain: "Weniger Routine. Mehr Wachstum."
patterns.reader_question: a question the reader answers for themselves: "Wie viel Potenzial steckt in Ihrem Unternehmen?"
patterns.bold_future: a bold statement about the near future that makes the reader curious: "2026 arbeitet jeder Mitarbeiter mit einem unsichtbaren Kollegen."
patterns.benefit_promise: the result the reader wants, as a promise: "Jede Anfrage verdient eine Antwort"
